name: ensemble
description: Multi-model agent ensembles. Scenes (one TypeScript file) define nodes — any model, scoped skills/state — wired by conditional edges, executed over OpenRouter/opencode.

routines.smoke: node src/cli.ts run scenes/smoke.yaml "Which AI model are you? Name your vendor and model precisely."

panes.name: run
panes.description: Primary pane for executing scenes: `node src/cli.ts run scenes/<scene>.yaml "<goal>"`. Runs are long-lived and stream per-node output, so keep this pane dedicated to them.

panes.name: check
panes.description: Typecheck and validation loop: `npx tsc --noEmit` and `node src/cli.ts validate scenes/*.yaml`. Validation is free, so run it here before spending tokens on a run.

panes.name: shell
panes.description: Free shell for ad-hoc work — editing scenes, inspecting .graph/runs/<id>/state.json, or checking `opencode models`. Kept empty so the run pane is never interrupted.

panes.name: graphviz
panes.description: Render scene topology: `node src/cli.ts view scenes/<scene>.yaml` for the terminal sketch, `--mermaid` for diagram source, or `--html=g.html` for a browser view.

panes.name: artifacts
panes.description: Inspect run output under .graph/runs/<timestamp>-<scene>/ — `state.json` is the checkpointed blackboard, `result.md` renders every state key.
